build_dataset_importer_builder: build a DatasetImporterBuilder subclass that proxies RLDS data files from GCS into TFDS format
create_dataset_info: create dataset metadata by calling _info to return a DatasetInfo with stripped keys and features
generate_examples_from_split: generate examples from a TFDS split using Beam pipelines that decode and convert to numpy
get_ds_builder_from_gcs: get a DatasetBuilder from a GCS location using builder_from_directory
strip_keys_from_features: strip metadata keys like episode_id and session_pb from dataset features before returning info
